scenario: Status flip on cortical sulci + SPU on sinus + merge of medulla/cerebellum
description: Real subset of brain-mr/findings_{gt,pred}/example_1 (negative scan in gt, pred adds two abnormalities and merges some completeness statements). Demonstrates a status flip on hemispheric cortical sulci (gt 'compatible with age' = normal vs pred 'mildly prominent for age' = abnormal — INC downstream), a hallucinated abnormality (SPU on left maxillary sinus mucosal thickening), and a split/merge artifact where pred fuses two gt findings (medulla/pons/mesencephalon + cerebellum) into one — that merged pred entity is matched against the better-fitting gt finding and the other becomes MIS.

pred_findings.text: Medulla oblongata, pons, mesencephalon, both cerebellar hemispheres, and vermis parenchyma are normal.
Hemispheric cortical sulcal widths are mildly prominent for the patient's age.
Bilateral orbits and paranasal sinuses are normal.
Mucosal thickening in the left maxillary sinus.

gt_findings.text: Medulla oblongata, pons, mesencephalon are normal.
Both cerebellar hemispheres and vermis parenchyma are normal.
Hemispheric cortical sulcal widths are compatible with the patient's age.

matches.reasoning: Pred merges medulla/pons/mesencephalon with cerebellum into a single completeness statement; aligned with the gt's medulla/pons/mesencephalon entry. The unmatched gt cerebellum statement is the split/merge artifact.
Same anatomy (hemispheric cortical sulci). Pred says 'mildly prominent for age' (abnormal), gt says 'compatible with age' (normal) — status flip kept in matches so Stage 3 can classify INC.
Pred merges orbits + paranasal sinuses into a single completeness statement; the closer gt counterpart is the paranasal sinuses statement.
